name: Context-GS
aliases: Compact 3D Gaussian Splatting with Anchor Level Context Model
definition: A method that adopts context-aware approaches that explicitly model hierarchical relationships among anchors to enhance representational capacity, building on anchor-based representation.
summary: Context-GS is a structured 3D Gaussian Splatting compression method that enhances efficiency by explicitly modeling hierarchical relationships among anchor primitives for context-aware encoding.
